Name: AutoInsertAndPickArtisanThings
Author: Lucas8x
Description:
[b][center]Auto Insert and Pick Artisan Things[/center][/b]
[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucas8x/AutoInsertAndPickArtisanThings/main/.repo/preview.gif[/img]﻿[/center]
[center]Auto insert ingredients or pickup products when near an artisan equipment.[/center]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI 4.x[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿
[/list]

[b]Usage[/b]
Hold/Equip any fruit/vegetable/ingredient/product to automatically put that item in the nearby machines.
[b]

Options[/b]
Using Generic Mod Config Menu you can easily change these:
[list]
[*][b]Auto Insert[/b]: Automatically put ingredients into the machine.
[*][b]Auto Pìck[/b]: Automatically pick up ready items from the machine
[*][b]Detection Range[/b]: Distance between player and machine to take effect.
[*][b]Insert Keybind[/b]: Keybind to manually insert ingredients on machines within the radius. Remember to disable auto insert.
[*][b]Pickup Keybind[/b]: Keybind to manually pick up ready items from the machines within the radius. Remember to disable auto pickup.
[/list]

[b]Inspiration[/b]
[url=https://github.com/exconvinced]exconvinced[/url]'s AutoSeedAndFertilizer on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29465]NexusMods[/url].
